scoring_justification: Checker recomputes geometric parameters from the raw XYZ coordinates and compares to paper-reported values for conformer B using tolerances, no self-reported numbers trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for geometric parameters of conformer B
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: Ru-H: 2.027 Å, Si-H: 1.514 Å, Ru-Si: 3.311 Å, Ru-H-Si: 138.0°
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription from paper's computational results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's exact reported optimized geometry parameters for the most stable conformer B.

schema.description: XYZ file: line 1: number of atoms N; line 2: comment; following N lines: element_symbol x y z with coordinates in Ångströms.

outputs.description: Optimized Cartesian coordinates of the most stable conformer of the η1‑silane intermediate B. The hidden checker reads this file, parses atomic positions, and recomputes the Ru‑H bond length, Si‑H bond length, Ru···Si distance, and Ru‑H‑Si angle. Each computed value is compared to the paper’s reported values for conformer B within a tolerance; meeting the tolerance yields full credit.

output_contract.notes: NBO interaction energies are excluded because they require proprietary software; the reproduction target is the structural geometry parameters. The XYZ file must be produced from a genuine DFT optimization at the specified level of theory; a fabricated geometry will be detected by the checker through both internal consistency checks and deviation from the reference values.
